messages:
amanda: quick notethe /v1/generate docs show request_id in the JSON body in the curl example, but our OpenAPI defines X-Request-Id as a header. this confuses codegen and SDK users.
kevin: can you paste the curl snippet + openapi fragment?
amanda: curl currently: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model":"rwd-2-mini","prompt":"hi","request_id":"abc-123"}'
```
openapi fragment: 
```yaml
parameters:
  - name: X-Request-Id
    in: header
    required: false
    schema:
      type: string
    example: abc-123
```
lucas: ok we should standardize on header. python SDK accepts request_id param and maps it to the header  keep that but document the mapping.
sarah_p: i'll also search for other examples with request_id in the body (rerank, stream). we should remove those from examples and add header examples.
jordan: i'll open a small docs PR to: remove request_id from example bodies, add X-Request-Id header examples for generate/stream/rerank, and add a note in SDK snippets mapping request_id -> header. tagging reviewers.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5550  CI: build passed, linkcheck reported one missing anchor (will fix in same PR).
amanda: thanks. one extra line about why it's a header (propagates across proxies/tracing) would be helpful.
kevin: also clarify batching semantics: header is per-client-request, not per-batched-item.
jordan: noted; aiming to push in a couple hours. low-risk doc-only change.
amanda: i'll review after lunch. if you find other body occurrences drop file paths here and i'll add to PR checklist. :thumbsup:
